fields.title: Week of Nov 2 – Nov 8
fields.headline: 12 of 16 stores on standard; Venice is the one store at risk, $131K of monthly revenue.
fields.body:
**On standard: 12 of 16.** Downtown San Jose opened on Nov 2.

**At risk**
- **Venice Boulevard** — audit fell to 78 on the pastry case; reviews are slipping.

**Watch**
- **Capitol Hill** — two openers resigned on Nov 3.
- **Oakland Uptown** — road works on Broadway since Nov 2.

**Audit overdue**
- **Ballard** — last audited Oct 2.

fields.title: Week of Nov 9 – Nov 15
fields.headline: $391K of monthly revenue sits in 3 at-risk stores; 10 of 16 on standard and 2 audits overdue.
fields.body:
**Revenue at risk: $391,000 of $2,137,000 a month (18%)**, up from $131,000. **10 of 16** stores on standard, down from 12.

**At risk**
- **Mission Street** — score 24, $142K. Cooler at 46°F failed two critical items; three fixes past due. Action: compressor on Nov 20, re-audit Nov 21.
- **Capitol Hill** — score 30, $118K. Two openers resigned; closed early twice; sales 86% of target. Action: floaters and two hires by Nov 18.
- **Venice Boulevard** — score 36, $131K. Reviews 3.8 on slow mornings. Action: second register — **overdue since Nov 14**.

**Audit overdue**
- **Ballard** (45 days) — audit booked for Nov 19.
- **Hawthorne** (39 days) — not booked yet.

**Decisions for Monday**
1. Approve the floaters for Capitol Hill.
2. Get the Venice second register open this week.
3. Book Hawthorne’s audit.
